title: Settings
subtitle: Operational thresholds used across live tracking, alerts, and route deviation detection for your school.
gpsUpdateIntervalHelp: How often a driver's app is expected to send a location ping.
stopGeofenceRadiusHelp: How close a bus must be to a stop's coordinates to count as arrived.
routeDeviationThresholdHelp: How far off the planned route line a bus can be before a deviation alert fires.
pickupGracePeriodHelp: How long past a stop's scheduled time a pending pickup is allowed before it's flagged.
busOfflineThresholdHelp: How long without a GPS ping before a bus is marked offline.
